REVISE

**Immutable audit scope**

- PR: #20, `kb/intake-unsettled`, one commit / three changed files.
- Audited head: `030f0a8a343988996edfb69b62c682ed017c67eb`.
- Audited base: `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`.
- Pre-verdict state: OPEN + DRAFT + CLEAN/MERGEABLE; zero comments, zero reviews, successful `validate` run `30648445167`, job `91215550416`, both bound to the audited head/base. The job executed the intake tests, `validate-intake` against the exact base, OKF validation, visual-validator tests, and write-guard self-test.

**Evidence matrix**

| Receipt / attempt | Independent result | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `src-001` Gamefound Updated Rulebook product | HTTP 200, final URL unchanged, HTML. The creator is Orange Nebula and the body still identifies the item as the slightly tweaked/newest-printing rulebook and says it is included in every framework printed for that campaign. Current dynamic bytes/hash drifted (58,718 bytes, SHA-256 `81471a73fa78a79e7d75c29a2b4c21b40a0a2ae25d4a3e1680ec38ab4d442515`, versus receipted 58,709 bytes / `eee368...`), but the cited meaning reproduces. | Valid official campaign identity evidence; dynamic wrapper drift disclosed. It is not an official rulebook-file receipt. |
| `src-002` Gamers-HQ PDF | HTTP 200, final URL unchanged, `application/pdf`, 69,217,668 bytes, SHA-256 `2cc105d5430e176b2bb45265809c5adf0ea7f7e3dcde1b3546a3f66ab4f47a59`, 48 pages. PDF metadata is 2023-03-14. | Exact byte reproduction. Correctly labeled `provenance: secondary`; the `official_rules` role describes rules content and does not make the retailer mirror an official endpoint. |
| `src-003` Thomas P. King review | HTTP 200, final URL unchanged. Current dynamic HTML drifted (167,563 bytes, SHA-256 `35987a94aaad5359fe98c0af44c8ae360df00745bd0936d3b562cb6bde776276`, versus receipted 167,735 bytes / `ce0340...`), while the overview still states cooperative play, one planet/one scenario, three action dice, time-track pressure, and endurance loss. | Meaningful independent review; cited semantics reproduce, with dynamic wrapper drift disclosed. |
| `src-004` Stack Up review | HTTP 200, final URL unchanged, `text/html; charset=UTF-8`, 1,210,388 bytes, SHA-256 `bc0f66ba9151a2e329ef3f74d1bd9dfeec7670455ad5d6cdc43ea8560559f3a3`. | Exact reproduction; meaningful independent support for cooperative format and 2–4 players. |
| `src-005` gameplay visual | HTTP 200, final URL unchanged, `image/jpeg`, 84,328 bytes, SHA-256 `d64fff94a0fccff9e88bba3b9077d6ba656621992bb7027bddd151d2c2513805`, 678×508. The review page now returns HTTP 200 and links the `IMG_3141-1.jpeg` asset. Pixel inspection shows a real Unsettled player dashboard with focus dice, action spaces/cards, endurance/insight/comprehension tracks and markers—not a logo or placeholder. | Exact reproduction and meaningful, correctly bounded single visual. It remains only 1 of the required 4–8 references. |
| Orange Nebula attempts | `/pages/unsettled-board-game` reproduced HTTP 429 `local_rate_limited` and an empty browser page. The bare `/sitemap_pages_1.xml` reproduced as HTTP 400 with zero bytes. | These are valid observations, not proof that publisher materials do not exist. |

**Rulebook inspection and coverage arithmetic**

- The full 48-page PDF supports the updated-framework identity, collaborative all-players-versus-game format, modular framework + one-planet structure, each planet's own special rules/challenges, three focus cubes used for actions, and time/endurance pressure with shared defeat when the crew is unconscious. The setup chapter includes only starter/example Wenora material; no Grakkis text was found. It does not contain the complete rules-bearing corpora for Planet 001 or Planet 002.
- Governing-rules denominator is explicit and intelligible: updated framework + complete Wenora corpus + complete Grakkis corpus. Acquired `1 / 3 = 33.3%`; this part is reproducible and not padded.
- The ten factual groups are explicit and mutually intelligible, but the achieved count is wrong. PDF pages 4–5 are headed **Component List** and enumerate the **Base Framework** contents with quantities (focus cubes, markers, miniatures, discovery/scientific dice, resources, Scarab tiles, player dashboards, structure/trait/avatar tiles, comprehension/investigated/trigger tokens, main boards, and cheat sheets/rulebook). Therefore `exact updated framework component manifest` is acquired from `src-002`. The correct achieved arithmetic for the packet's own denominator is **7 / 10 = 70.0%**, not 6 / 10 = 60%.

**Bathcat-fixable defects and exact repairs**

1. In `evidence.json`, change `exact updated framework component manifest` to `recorded: true` with `source_ids: ["src-002"]`; tighten `src-002.locator` to include PDF pages 4–5, **Component List / Base Framework**. In `manifest.json` and the PR body, change factual coverage to `recorded: 7`, `known_total: 10`, `percent: 70`, and `7/10 = 70.0%`. Remove the framework manifest from residual missing evidence while preserving the still-missing exact Planet 001 and Planet 002 manifests.
2. `src-001` exposes an official files/download location that the packet omits: `https://www.orangenebula.com/creations/unsettled/` (currently redirects to `https://orangenebula.com/collections/unsettled` and reproduces HTTP 429). Preserve that locator and attempt explicitly; do not say the Gamefound item exposed no official location. State instead that it exposed the official location but no official file was successfully retrieved.
3. Correct the incomplete sitemap attempt ledger. `https://orangenebula.com/sitemap.xml` currently returns HTTP 200 (6,769 bytes), and its parameterized English child sitemaps also return HTTP 200, including `sitemap_pages_1.xml?from=122794770715&to=181908570395` and `sitemap_products_1.xml?from=8248430199067&to=10353100325147`. Record those exact final URLs/results and inspect the listed Unsettled page/product/collection endpoints. Preserve rate limits as observed failures; do not infer publisher absence from the failed bare child URL.

**Residual external gaps after repair**

- No publisher-hosted updated framework PDF has yet been receipted.
- Complete Planet 001 Wenora and Planet 002 Grakkis rules-bearing materials, including all planet-specific rules and survival tasks, remain unacquired.
- Exact Planet 001 and Planet 002 manifests remain open.
- Only one meaningful visual is receipted; 4–8 distinct references plus contact sheet remain required.

The packet is structurally lawful as blocked: one cooperative candidate in the declared 1/1/1 ceiling, `status: blocked`, no canonical staging, no `approval.json`, no promotion, no unsupported rating/weight claim, complete receipt fields, and both read-only committed-head gates returned `validate-intake: clean`. Green structure does not cure the false achieved percentage or incomplete official-source attempt ledger.

**Final disposition:** keep PR #20 OPEN + DRAFT and unmerged. No approval, promotion, ready transition, or merge is authorized. Auditor repository files modified: **none**. Merge performed: **no**.

## Bathcat repair handoff — NOT APPROVAL / DO NOT MERGE

**Receiver order:** Judge, then a **wholly fresh Mennonite** audit context. Prior audit and CI evidence remain bound only to the old head.

- Audited `REVISE` head: `030f0a8a343988996edfb69b62c682ed017c67eb`
- Repaired exact head: `cac06848d8330a1faf71ab9ec3e252d708c5a629`
- Exact base: `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`

### Repair mapping

1. **Coverage arithmetic:** `evidence.json` now records `exact updated framework component manifest` as true with `src-002`; its locator identifies rulebook pages 4–5, **Component List / Base Framework**. Manifest and PR body now report **7/10 = 70.0%**. The framework manifest was removed from the residual ledger; exact Planet 001 and Planet 002 manifests remain missing.
2. **Official locator:** the Gamefound-exposed `https://www.orangenebula.com/creations/unsettled/` is recorded. A bounded request redirected to `https://orangenebula.com/collections/unsettled` and returned HTTP 429 (`text/plain`, 18 bytes, SHA-256 `fa2dd01ed96d38758e89e354653c39f366bc7a34e485772c8aa2174b53a465d3`). The official location is exposed; no official rulebook file was retrieved.
3. **Sitemap ledger:** the root and parameterized English page/product/collection sitemaps were independently receipted at HTTP 200. Root: 6,769 bytes / `1a585c058a0828816ab781dd2e798d5d1f6e537083801990a87479cf54f4c309`; pages: 6,284 / `6d5a074cde9f4e696886f58b6e7ac64ec227e22f5d1c1eb8bedc1e745cc0af6c`; products: 62,326 / `7ee0fdc8b854955a31e9f947720a16dd3f84d7d17ff6afbab927ab48a69a0bf2`; collections: 6,596 / `dfe6050532b61ac18085b25711a54f3fb3b1e8271e18350fc25135a5f743a635`. The listed two pages, two scope-relevant products, and two collections were boundedly inspected and returned the same HTTP 429 receipt; no absence inference was made.

### Preserved boundaries

- Governing rules remain **1/3 = 33.3%**; updated framework mirror acquired, complete Wenora and Grakkis corpora missing.
- `src-002` remains a retailer mirror with `provenance: secondary`, not an official publisher-file receipt.
- Both independent reviews and the existing visual receipt remain unchanged.
- Visual coverage remains one meaningful reference; 4–8 plus a contact sheet are required.
- Packet remains `blocked`; no canonical staging tree and no `approval.json` exist.

### Residual HOLD conditions

- no publisher-hosted updated framework PDF receipt;
- complete Planet 001 and Planet 002 rules-bearing materials remain unacquired;
- exact Planet 001 and Planet 002 component/rules manifests remain open;
- official FAQ/errata applicability remains open;
- three or more additional meaningful visuals plus contact sheet remain required.

### Verification

- focused run validator: clean;
- final full validator: 2,611 files clean and index fresh;
- complete local test denominator: 36 passed, 1 intentional skip, 0 failed;
- committed-head intake gate and diff check: clean;
- exact-head CI: [run 30663831440 / job 91266036383](https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30663831440/job/91266036383) — **SUCCESS** on `cac06848d8330a1faf71ab9ec3e252d708c5a629`.

**Disposition remains OPEN + DRAFT + unmerged.** Bathcat did not approve, promote, mark ready, create approval, or merge. Fresh Mennonite must audit the new full SHA independently.

HOLD — GAP PACKET ACCEPTED

**Immutable scope and state**

- Audited PR #20 at exact head `143ed8d473dc3adccbfe7f74fc60a1fa5d49cba5` over base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`.
- Local HEAD, upstream, remote branch, and `refs/pull/20/head` all matched that head; `origin/main` matched the base; the worktree was clean.
- The full three-commit diff is 240 insertions across only `TELEMETRY.md`, `intake/runs/2026-07-31-unsettled/manifest.json`, and `intake/runs/2026-07-31-unsettled/candidates/unsettled/evidence.json`. The terminal micro-correction from `cac06848d8330a1faf71ab9ec3e252d708c5a629` changes only the page-sitemap hash from a 63-character transcription to the exact 64-character receipt ending in `...af6c`.

**Prior-defect closure matrix**

1. **Closed — framework manifest and arithmetic.** The retailer-mirror PDF reproduced exactly: HTTP 200, final URL unchanged, `application/pdf`, 69,217,668 bytes, SHA-256 `2cc105d5430e176b2bb45265809c5adf0ea7f7e3dcde1b3546a3f66ab4f47a59`, 48 pages, 2023-03-14 metadata. Pages 4–5, **Component List / Base Framework**, enumerate the framework contents and support the repaired `src-002` locator. The packet now correctly records governing coverage `1/3 = 33.3%` and factual coverage `7/10 = 70.0%`; the seven true factual rows each cite declared sources, while the Planet 001 manifest, Planet 002 manifest, and printing-specific FAQ/errata rows remain false.
2. **Closed — official locator meaning.** The live Gamefound product remained HTTP 200 and still says the updated rulebook is included in every framework printed for that campaign, identifies the most recent version as living in the files/downloads area, and exposes `https://www.orangenebula.com/creations/unsettled/`. That locator still redirects to `https://orangenebula.com/collections/unsettled` and returns HTTP 429, `text/plain`, 18 bytes, SHA-256 `fa2dd01ed96d38758e89e354653c39f366bc7a34e485772c8aa2174b53a465d3`. The packet correctly records the official location without claiming an official PDF was retrieved.
3. **Closed — sitemap and bounded endpoint ledger.** The retained exact receipts reproduce the stated final URLs/status/MIME/bytes/hashes: root 6,769 / `1a585c058a0828816ab781dd2e798d5d1f6e537083801990a87479cf54f4c309`; pages 6,284 / corrected `6d5a074cde9f4e696886f58b6e7ac64ec227e22f5d1c1eb8bedc1e745cc0af6c`; products 62,326 / `7ee0fdc8b854955a31e9f947720a16dd3f84d7d17ff6afbab927ab48a69a0bf2`; collections 6,596 / `dfe6050532b61ac18085b25711a54f3fb3b1e8271e18350fc25135a5f743a635`. The parameterized children enumerate exactly 2 Unsettled pages, 17 Unsettled products, and 2 Unsettled collections. Both pages, the scoped framework/Planets 001–002 and Survival Task Pack 1–2 products, and both collections were each boundedly inspected and reproduce HTTP 429 / `text/plain` / 18 bytes / `fa2dd0…65d3`; the packet makes no absence inference. A fresh product-sitemap fetch retained the same 62,326 bytes and same URL inventory but changed hash only because Shopify advanced uniform `<lastmod>` timestamps; this disclosed live drift does not invalidate the timestamped retained receipt.

**Evidence and remaining boundary**

- `src-002` remains correctly marked `provenance: secondary`; its `official_rules` role does not turn the retailer mirror into a publisher endpoint.
- The framework PDF contains generic/example Wenora material but no Grakkis corpus and does not contain complete Planet 001 or Planet 002 rules-bearing materials or exact planet manifests. Those governing authorities remain genuinely open.
- Both independent reviews still reproduce their cited meaning. The Stack Up receipt reproduces exactly at 1,210,388 bytes / `bc0f66ba9151a2e329ef3f74d1bd9dfeec7670455ad5d6cdc43ea8560559f3a3`; the Thomas P. King wrapper drifted while preserving cooperative/one-planet/one-scenario/three-dice/time/endurance meaning.
- `src-005` reproduces exactly at 84,328 bytes / `d64fff94a0fccff9e88bba3b9077d6ba656621992bb7027bddd151d2c2513805`, 678×508. Pixel inspection shows a meaningful Unsettled player dashboard with focus dice, action spaces/cards, and endurance/insight/comprehension tracks—not a logo or placeholder. It remains only one visual; 4–8 references plus a contact sheet are required.
- The packet is `blocked`; receipt schema/source references are complete; no canonical tree or `approval.json` exists; no canonical game path changed. The four telemetry additions are the two original and two repair final-writer rows. Focused and diff-aware read-only intake gates both returned clean.
- Exact-head CI [run 30664262026 / job 91267415974](https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30664262026/job/91267415974) is `SUCCESS` on `143ed8d473dc3adccbfe7f74fc60a1fa5d49cba5`; substantive intake/provenance tests reported 31 pass, 1 intentional skip, 0 fail, followed by clean intake/OKF/visual/write-guard gates.
- The current PR body and superseding handoff are bound to the corrected head. The intermediate `cac0684…` handoff remains historical provenance and is explicitly superseded; no stale live readiness or approval claim remains.

**Residual HOLD conditions:** no publisher-hosted updated framework PDF receipt; complete Planet 001 Wenora and Planet 002 Grakkis rules-bearing corpora and exact manifests remain unacquired; printing-specific official FAQ/errata applicability remains open; and at least three additional meaningful visuals plus a contact sheet remain required. These are external evidence gaps, not remaining Bathcat-fixable defects in this repaired packet.

**Final disposition:** repair lane accepted into the audited open-gap lane. Keep PR #20 OPEN + DRAFT and unmerged. No approval, promotion, ready transition, canonical write, review approval, or merge is authorized. Auditor repository files modified: **none**. Merge performed: **no**. Receiver: **Judge**.

GO — MERGE

T's corrected law controls: the accepted gap-packet audit is a passing audit for this evidence PR, while its semantic `blocked` status and residual evidence gaps remain in-repo; squash-merge exact head `143ed8d473dc3adccbfe7f74fc60a1fa5d49cba5` over audited base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`, protected by successful exact-head check https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30664262026/job/91267415974.
